column3: The Hebrew does not name who appeared; NASB supplies “the LORD.” “Which he had prepared in the place of David” is rendered “at the place that David had prepared.”
NASB reorders the date; “on the second” is rendered “on the second day.”
“The founding of Solomon” is rendered “the foundations which Solomon laid”; “the former measurement” is rendered “the old standard.”
“On the face of the length on the face of the breadth” is rendered “as long as the width.” The height of 120 matches the Hebrew.
“The great house” is rendered “the main room,” and “put up on it” as “ornamented it with.”
“The house of the holy of holies” is rendered “the room of the holy of holies,” and “to talents” as “amounting to.”
“A work of castings” is rendered “sculptured”; the meaning of the Hebrew word is uncertain.
The Hebrew has “the one cherub” and “the other cherub”; NASB renders these as “the other cherub” and “the first cherub.” “Clinging to” is rendered “was attached to.”
“Spreading out” is rendered “extended,” and “their faces were to the inside” as “facing the main room.”
“In the innermost room” is rendered “in the inner sanctuary”; the meaning of this phrase is uncertain.
